taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Ndashi (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 13.515 | 0.49701 | 0.49701
2 | 1257.2 | 1.5896 | 2.0866
3 | 2041.3 | 4.5367 | 6.6232
4 | 1765.4 | 17.594 | 24.217
5 | 77.636 | 16.33 | 30.85
6 | 2384.1 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Reference note: Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station: Ndashi
Curve type: AKQH
Aquifer depth: 24.2 – 40.5 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of at least 42 to 45 m to fully penetrate the low-resistivity aquifer layer (Layer 5) before terminating in the underlying resistive basement/bedrock. Install well screens across the 24.2 to 40.5 m interval with a proper gravel pack.
